results.name: Glassmorphism Folder Cards
results.description: Glassmorphism folder cards: frosted-glass folders that assemble on scroll, lean toward the pointer, open to fan out their files as clickable items, and take new files with a drop-in animation. Keyboard and menu support built in. React only, no images or fonts to ship.
results.author: kedhareswer

results.name: AI Feature Showcase Section
results.description: A two-row feature section that pairs images with animated marquee tag pills and an AI chat mockup to highlight product capabilities for different teams.
results.author: shadcnspace
